title: A pool run's --max-usd cap counts the runs in flight and its dry run prices the kinds it runs, so a capped run neither passes its cap nor stops short of its rows
goal: benchmarks.py run pool starts no run once the finished runs plus the runs in flight, each at its kind's mean cost, would pass --max-usd, and --dry-run prices each kind at its own mean cost, not the all-kinds mean (SP-kp3boz7z: ST-qm6wuqq4's paid run, 60 runs on sc_absent and sc_partial with --jobs 8, was estimated at 3.51 USD, billed 5.72 USD against a 5 USD cap and stopped 3 runs short)
